29210.name: PITAKA Iphone 17 Pro Max Summa Case (Sunset)

bullets.title: Tough yet Elegant
bullets.text: Ultimate fusion of rugged durability and premium craftsmanship. Engineered to deliver elite protection with a sleek, modern finish.

bullets.title: Orca Resin
bullets.text: PITAKA's Orca resin, fused with aramid fiber, boosts strength by 200% and doubles impact resistance. Paired with TPU's elasticity, it delivers dual-layer defense hard protection and soft cushioning surpassing traditional thermosetting resins.

bullets.title: Premium Weave
bullets.text: Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, our case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It's not just light and strong it's a pleasure to hold, every single time.

bullets.title: Upgraded Capative Button
bullets.text: Featuring high-strength glass to protect camera buttons well and preserve touch sensitivity. Ensures your operations remain smooth.

bullets.title: Be Light, Be Lively
bullets.text: Recreating the first popular item of the Weaving+ series "Sunset Moment", we have woven an immersive blue time from sunset to moonrise.

bullets.title: Stability in Every Mode
bullets.text: Sturdy zinc alloy stand with a double-ring design provides strong support, keeping your phone stable in both landscape and portrait modes and freeing your hands.

bullets.title: Easy Grip by One Hand
bullets.text: The dual-ring magnetic design helps you use your phone more easily. It provides stable support whether you're holding, taking photos, or controlling the Capture Button with one hand, user-friendly even for small hands.

bullets.title: Strong Magnetic Force
bullets.text: The MagSafe grip features powerful magnets that snap into place effortlessly. With a magnetic strength of up to 1.2kg, it allows you to carry your device with just a finger, giving you peace of mind that your phone won't slip or drop. Magnetic Strength: 1.2kg.

bullets.title: Sleek and Secure
bullets.text: At a mere 5.9mm thick, the grip easily slips into your pocket without adding bulk. Placed on the desk, it elevates your phone to keep the lenses scratch-free.

bullets.title: Small Details, Big Difference
bullets.text: Aramid fiber repurposed from camera ring leftovers reduces resources.

bullets.title: The Inspiration of a Thread
bullets.text: PITAKA's story begins with a thread of aramid fiber, a line that symbolizes our ongoing spirit of self-reflection and reinvention, reminding us to sweep away distractions and embrace purity. Inspired by this thread, we reimagined PITAKA's logo, turning it's initials into an artistic monogram design. It's our tribute to those bold enough to erase impurities and refine themselves.

bullets.title: Text Weaving to New Heights
bullets.text: Through the intricate interlacing of lightweight yet durable aramid fibers, the woven text on the case offers a unique and classic aesthetic while revealing refined textures that provide a delightful tactile experience.
